Great speaking with you earlier today. Per our discovery call, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to capture milestones, owners, dependencies, and a proposed target close date. Please find the first draft attached.

- Discovery complete (done) — Marissa
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence — owner: Erin — due: 2027-07-25
- Pricing approval & PO terms — owner: Samir — due: 2027-08-01
- Procurement & legal review — owner: Novafin Legal — target close: 2027-08-12
- Pilot scheduling & onboarding — owner: Redwood Customer Success (TBD) — start: 2027-08-15

Open / dependencies:
- We need your confirmation on the PO billing cadence (monthly vs annual) so we can firm pricing.
- Legal will request SOC2 and data handling docs — I can send our compliance pack as soon as you confirm.

1) Can you confirm owners and the target close date above?
2) If the procurement timeline looks tight, let us know and we can propose a phased rollout.

Thanks — I’ll follow up next week with a checkpoint and updated MAP.
